{{Quote|Two years out of Anaxes, I was sent on a peacekeeping mission to the Sepan sector. It was the Dimoks and the Ripoblus, as it has been for centuries. We separated their ships, patrolled the trade routes, and did all the things you'd expect. The army had it worse&mdash;they were down on Kuthard, with its mixed population, sitting in walkers and wheelies, keeping Dims and Rips apart.|Gar Stazi's [[Holomessage/Legends|holomessage]] to [[Jhoram Bey]]|<ref name="TEGtW" />}}
'''Kuthard''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]],<ref name="Email" /> a part of the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|If we defeat Darth Krayt, the galaxy will be at peace. For a while, anyway&mdash;maybe long enough for us to get old and sit on a porch somewhere and convince ourselves we were heroes. But then there will be war again. And new killers will be called. I think that day on Kuthard was the last day I believed in peace, Jhoram.|Gar Stazi's holomessage to Jhoram Bey|<ref name="TEGtW" />}}
It was a [[Peacekeeping mission to the Sepan sector|visit]] to Kuthard, several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[130 ABY]], that changed [[Galactic Alliance officer]] [[Gar Stazi]]'s opinion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and its chances for peace after he conversed with an [[Unidentified Dimok crone|elderly Dimok]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', confirmed in [[June]] [[2015]] that Kuthard was a planet located in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]].<ref name="Email" />
